note: Card effects are summarised in original wording for rule evaluation. Not a reproduction of card text.

rgg-2e-rulebook.title: Rio Grande Games - Dominion 2nd Edition rulebook

cards.name: Copper
cards.text: Treasure worth $1.

cards.name: Silver
cards.text: Treasure worth $2.

cards.name: Gold
cards.text: Treasure worth $3.

cards.name: Estate
cards.text: Worth 1 VP.

cards.name: Duchy
cards.text: Worth 3 VP.

cards.name: Province
cards.text: Worth 6 VP.

cards.name: Curse
cards.text: Worth -1 VP.

cards.name: Cellar
cards.text: +1 Action. Discard any number of cards from hand, then draw that many.
manual_steps: Cellar: discard any number of cards from your hand, then draw the same number. Update your hand.

cards.name: Chapel
cards.text: Trash up to 4 cards from your hand.
manual_steps: Chapel: trash up to 4 cards from your hand. Update your hand and deck list.
rulings: Chapel cannot trash itself (it is already in play).

cards.name: Moat
cards.text: +2 Cards. Reaction: when another player plays an Attack, you may reveal this from hand to be unaffected.
rulings: Revealing Moat keeps it in hand; it can be revealed against several Attacks.

cards.name: Harbinger
cards.text: +1 Card, +1 Action. Look through your discard pile; you may put a card from it onto your deck.
manual_steps: Harbinger: you may put one card from your discard pile onto your deck.

cards.name: Merchant
cards.text: +1 Card, +1 Action. The first time you play a Silver this turn, +$1.
rulings: Each Merchant played adds +$1 to the first Silver played that turn only.

cards.name: Vassal
cards.text: +$2. Discard the top card of your deck; if it is an Action card you may play it.
manual_steps: Vassal: discard the top card of your deck. If it is an Action, you may play it (no Action used) - apply its effect manually.

cards.name: Village
cards.text: +1 Card, +2 Actions.

cards.name: Workshop
cards.text: Gain a card costing up to $4.
manual_steps: Workshop: gain a card costing up to $4 (to your discard pile). Update the Supply and your deck list.

cards.name: Bureaucrat
cards.text: Gain a Silver onto your deck. Each other player puts a Victory card from hand onto their deck (or reveals a hand with none).
manual_steps: Bureaucrat attack: each other player puts a Victory card from hand onto their deck (Moat may block).

cards.name: Gardens
cards.text: Worth 1 VP per 10 cards you own (round down).

cards.name: Militia
cards.text: +$2. Each other player discards down to 3 cards in hand.
manual_steps: Militia attack: each other player discards down to 3 cards in hand (Moat may block).

cards.name: Moneylender
cards.text: You may trash a Copper from your hand; if you do, +$3.
rulings: +$3 only if a Copper was actually trashed.

cards.name: Poacher
cards.text: +1 Card, +1 Action, +$1. Discard a card per empty Supply pile.
rulings: Draw first, then discard; discard only as many cards as you have.

cards.name: Remodel
cards.text: Trash a card from your hand; gain a card costing up to $2 more than it.
manual_steps: Remodel: trash a card from your hand and gain a card costing up to $2 more than it. Update hand, Supply and deck list.
rulings: Remodel cannot trash itself. The gained card may be a copy of the trashed one.

cards.name: Smithy
cards.text: +3 Cards.

cards.name: Throne Room
cards.text: You may play an Action card from your hand twice.
rulings: Playing the chosen card twice does not use Actions.
Optional: you may choose not to play a card.

cards.name: Bandit
cards.text: Gain a Gold. Each other player reveals their top 2 cards, trashes a revealed Treasure other than Copper, and discards the rest.
manual_steps: Bandit attack: each other player reveals their top 2 cards, trashes a non-Copper Treasure among them, discards the rest (Moat may block).

cards.name: Council Room
cards.text: +4 Cards, +1 Buy. Each other player draws a card.
manual_steps: Council Room: each other player draws a card.

cards.name: Festival
cards.text: +2 Actions, +1 Buy, +$2.

cards.name: Laboratory
cards.text: +2 Cards, +1 Action.

cards.name: Library
cards.text: Draw until you have 7 cards in hand; you may set aside Action cards drawn this way, discarding them afterwards.
manual_steps: Library: while drawing to 7, you may set aside any Action cards you draw (they are discarded afterwards). Enter the cards you kept.

cards.name: Market
cards.text: +1 Card, +1 Action, +1 Buy, +$1.

cards.name: Mine
cards.text: You may trash a Treasure from your hand; gain a Treasure to your hand costing up to $3 more than it.
manual_steps: Mine: you may trash a Treasure from hand and gain a Treasure costing up to $3 more into your hand. Update hand, Supply and deck list.

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: +1 Card, +1 Action. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck; trash and/or discard any of them; put the rest back in any order.
manual_steps: Sentry: look at your top 2 cards; trash and/or discard any number; put the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Witch
cards.text: +2 Cards. Each other player gains a Curse.
manual_steps: Witch attack: each other player gains a Curse in turn order while Curses remain (Moat may block). Update the Curse pile.
rulings: With no Curses left, Witch still gives +2 Cards.

cards.name: Artisan
cards.text: Gain a card to your hand costing up to $5; then put a card from your hand onto your deck.
manual_steps: Artisan: gain a card costing up to $5 into your hand, then put a card from your hand onto your deck. Update hand, Supply and deck list.
